DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらのお弁当は表示どおりのお値段です。何か気になる点がございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: This boxed meal costs the displayed price. Is there anything you are concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 棚に半額と書いてあったので、この弁当も半額だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 半額だと思った棚の表示について尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: The shelf said half price, so I thought this boxed meal was half price too.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask about the shelf display that made you think the meal was half price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 半額のシールは、隣の種類のお弁当の容器に付いていました。こちらにはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: The half-price sticker was on the container of the different boxed meal beside it. This one has no sticker.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 棚全体の案内だと思ったんです。自分でシールを貼り替えてはいけませんよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 値引きシールを自分で移してはいけないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I thought it applied to the whole shelf. I must not move the sticker myself, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm that you must not move a discount sticker yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、貼り替えず、そのままお持ちください。どちらのお弁当をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Correct, please leave it as it is without moving the sticker. Which boxed meal would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 値引きされた方を見直したいです。この弁当の会計をいったん待ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 会計を待って商品を選び直したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I would like another look at the discounted one. Could you put checkout for this meal on hold?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to pause checkout so you can choose your item again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらはまだ会計していませんので、選び直せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Certainly. This has not been checked out yet, so you can choose again.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では、半額の弁当の中身を確認します。苦手な魚が入っていれば元の方にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 値引き商品に苦手な魚が入っているか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then I will check what is in the half-price meal. If it contains fish I dislike, I will take the original one.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check whether the discounted item contains fish you dislike. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 半額の方は魚のお弁当です。元の商品は鶏肉です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: The half-price one is a fish meal. Your original choice is chicken.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: それなら値段より中身を優先して、鶏肉の弁当を表示の値段で買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 中身を優先し元の商品を通常価格で買うと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: In that case, I will prioritize the contents over the price and buy the chicken meal at the displayed price.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Decide to prioritize the contents and buy your original choice at the regular price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: かしこまりました。鶏肉のお弁当一つで会計いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Certainly. I will ring up one chicken boxed meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ラーメンをお持ちしました。追加の麺は、あとでお声がけいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Here is your ramen. Please let us know later when you want the extra noodles.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: あとでではなく、最初から麺が多いものを頼んだつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 最初から多い麺を希望していたと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I meant to order more noodles from the start, rather than later.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Correct the order by explaining that you wanted more noodles from the beginning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 先ほどの「麺を追加」は替え玉として受け付けました。大盛りのご希望だったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I took your earlier request for extra noodles as a refill. You wanted a large serving, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、違いを知らずに言いました。今のラーメンは普通の量ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 現在の麺の量を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, I said it without knowing the difference. Is the ramen here a regular serving?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check the quantity of noodles in your current bowl. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、普通の量です。もう出来上がっているので、まず対応を厨房に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, it is a regular serving. Since it is already prepared, I will first check with the kitchen what we can do.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 作り直してほしいと決めたわけではありません。追加料金と出し方を聞いてから選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 作り直しを即決せず料金と対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have not decided that I want it remade. I would like to choose after hearing the extra charge and how it would be served.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask about the charge and available arrangements without immediately deciding to have it remade. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 確認しました。この場面では、別の器で麺を追加できます。大盛りへの作り直しはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have checked. In this situation, we can provide extra noodles in a separate bowl. We cannot remake it as a large serving.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 別の器なら、自分で少しずつ入れられますね。追加分の料金はいくらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 別器で出す追加麺の料金を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: With a separate bowl, I can add them a little at a time myself. How much are the extra noodles?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check the price of extra noodles served in a separate bowl. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 追加分は百五十円です。まだ追加の調理は始めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The extra noodles cost one hundred fifty yen. We have not started cooking them yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: では百五十円の追加をお願いします。今度は最初に大盛りと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 追加注文を決め今後の注文表現を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Then I will have the extra noodles for one hundred fifty yen. Next time, I will ask for a large serving at the start.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Decide to order the extra noodles and show that you understand how to order next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。追加の麺は別の器でお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Certainly. I will bring the extra noodles in a separate bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 本日は定期検診のご予約ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Your appointment today is for a routine checkup, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 予約した時はそうだったのですが、昨日、奥の歯が少し欠けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 予約後に歯が欠けたと受付の認識を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: That was the case when I booked, but yesterday one of my back teeth chipped a little.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Correct reception's understanding by saying your tooth chipped after you booked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 予約後に状態が変わったのですね。今、痛みなどはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: So your condition changed after booking. Do you have any pain or other symptoms now?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 噛むと痛いです。何もしない時はあまり痛みませんが、受付だけで伝えて大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 噛む時の痛みと情報の伝達先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: It hurts when I bite. It does not hurt much when I do nothing, but is telling reception enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Describe the pain when biting and check who will receive the information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 受付から担当者に伝えます。いつ、どんな時に欠けたかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Reception will tell the person in charge. Please also tell us when and under what circumstances it chipped.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 昨日の夕食中です。硬い物を噛んだかは覚えていないので、分かることだけ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 発生時を述べ不明な原因は推測しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: It was during dinner yesterday. I do not remember whether I bit something hard, so I will only tell you what I know.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: State when it happened without guessing an unknown cause. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。欠けた部分を何かで貼り付けたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. Did you attach the chipped part with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 何も付けていません。取れた小さいかけらは袋に入れて持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 処置していないことと持参したかけらを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have not put anything on it. I put the small piece that came off in a bag and brought it.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you have not treated it and have brought the chipped piece. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 袋はそのままお持ちください。診療内容や順番は、担当者が状態を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please keep the bag as it is. We will explain the treatment and order after the person in charge checks your condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 分かりました。定期検診の予定だけで進まず、欠けたことと噛む時の痛みを伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 検診の予定に加えて現在の症状を引き継いでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. Please do not proceed only on the routine-checkup plan; tell them about the chip and the pain when biting too.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Ask for your current symptoms to be handed over along with the planned checkup. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい、予約後の変化も記録し、担当者に引き継ぎます。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Yes, we will record the changes since booking and hand them over. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三名様の名前が画面に入りました。貸し靴も三足でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: All three names are on the screen. Would you like three pairs of rental shoes too?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三人で来ましたが、投げるのは二人です。一人は見学だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 来場人数と投球人数の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Three of us came, but only two will bowl. One person is just watching.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the number of visitors and the number bowling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 失礼しました。見学の方のお名前はどちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: My mistake. Which name belongs to the spectator?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三番目のミナです。まだ誰も投げていないので、先に画面から外してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 投球前に見学者の名前を画面から外すよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Mina, the third name. Nobody has bowled yet, so could you remove her from the screen first?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask for the spectator's name to be removed from the screen before bowling begins. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、投球者は二名に直します。靴はもう受け取っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, I will change it to two bowlers. Have you received your shoes yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三足受け取りましたが、ミナの分はまだ履いていません。この一足を返したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 未使用の貸し靴を返したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: We received three pairs, but Mina has not worn hers yet. I would like to return this pair.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you want to return the unused rental shoes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 未使用の一足をお預かりします。この場面では靴の会計も二足に訂正できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will take the unused pair. In this situation, we can also correct the shoe charge to two pairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。投球料金と靴代が両方二人分になったか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 投球料金と靴代の両方の訂正を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. I would like to check that both the bowling fee and shoe charge are now for two people.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check the corrections to both the bowling and shoe charges. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらが訂正後の明細です。投球は二名、靴も二足です。画面も二名になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Here is the corrected breakdown. Two bowlers and two pairs of shoes. The screen also shows two people.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 確認できました。ミナは見学席に座ります。二人の名前の順番は今のままでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 見学者の位置と投球者の順番を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I have checked. Mina will sit in the spectator seats. Please leave the two bowlers' names in their current order.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm where the spectator will sit and the bowlers' order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。二名の順番は変えていません。準備ができたら始めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Certainly. I have not changed the two players' order. Start when you are ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: どちらまで行かれますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 海浜駅です。この列車の表示に海浜とありますが、前と後ろで行き先が違うと聞こえました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 列車の前後で行き先が違う案内を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Kaihin Station. This train's display says Kaihin, but I thought I heard that the front and rear have different destinations.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check the announcement about different destinations for the train's front and rear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この場面では、途中で車両を分けます。海浜方面は前の二両です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: In this situation, the train splits along the route. The front two cars go toward Kaihin.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 列車のどこに乗っても同じ駅まで行けるわけではないんですね。ここは後ろ側ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 目的方面の車両と現在の乗車位置を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: So I cannot reach the same station from just any part of the train. Is this the rear section?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Distinguish the cars for your destination from your current boarding position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、ここは後ろ側の乗車位置です。前の二両の目印は、向こうにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, this is the boarding position for the rear section. The marker for the front two cars is over there.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 大きい荷物があるので、乗ってから車内を移るより、ホームで前の位置へ移りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 荷物のため車内移動ではなくホームで移動したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have large luggage, so I would rather move to the front position on the platform than move through the train after boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that because of your luggage, you want to move along the platform rather than inside the train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 出発前に安全に移れるか、係員が案内します。車内の通路が必ず通れるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: An attendant will advise whether you can move safely before departure. The passage inside the train is not always accessible.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分かりました。急いで走ったり、扉の閉まる直前に荷物を押し込んだりせず、案内を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 出発直前の無理な移動を避け案内を受ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. I will follow their guidance without running in a rush or pushing my luggage in just before the doors close.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Avoid forcing a move just before departure and accept staff guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。間に合わない場合は無理に乗らず、次の便をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. If there is not enough time, do not force your way on; we will show you the next service.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: お願いします。列車の行き先だけでなく、自分が乗る前の二両の表示も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 列車全体と乗る車両の表示を両方確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please do. I will check the front two cars' display where I board as well as the train's destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Decide to check both the whole train's destination and the display on the cars you will board. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。荷物を持ってこちらで少しお待ちください。係員が乗車位置をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Certainly. Please wait here briefly with your luggage. An attendant will show you the boarding position.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの封筒をお送りですね。中身について確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: You would like to send this envelope, correct? Is there anything you want to check about its contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 申請書と返送用封筒を入れましたが、小さい返送用封筒にも封をしてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 返送用封筒にも封をしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I put in the application and return envelope, but I sealed the small return envelope too.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you sealed the return envelope too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 返送先の説明には、その封筒をどう入れるよう書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: What do the recipient's instructions say about enclosing that envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 説明には「切手を貼った返信用封筒を同封」とあります。封をするとは書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 申請先の説明の文言を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: The instructions say to enclose a stamped self-addressed reply envelope. They do not say to seal it.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Quote the wording of the application recipient's instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらでは申請先の受付条件までは判断できません。説明を確認してから直しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: We cannot determine the application recipient's acceptance requirements here. Would you like to check the instructions before correcting it?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。このまま発送しないでください。大きい封筒を開けて、中の封筒を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 発送を止め自分で中身を確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Please do not send it as it is. I would like to open the large envelope and check the envelope inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to stop dispatch so you can check the contents yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まだお預かりしていませんので、ご自身で開けられます。開封で傷んだら新しい封筒も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: We have not accepted it yet, so you can open it yourself. If opening damages it, you will need a new envelope too.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 小さい封筒の口が破れました。新しい物に住所を書き直し、申請先にも入れ方を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 破れた封筒を交換し入れ方を申請先へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: The opening of the small envelope tore. I will write the address again on a new one and ask the application recipient how to enclose it.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will replace the torn envelope and ask the application recipient how to enclose it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。貼った切手をどう扱うかは、状態を見て別に確認いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. We will separately check what to do about the attached stamp after looking at its condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。返信用の準備ができてから、改めて発送をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 返送用封筒の準備後に発送すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. I will ask you to send it again once the reply envelope is ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Decide to send it after preparing the return envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は発送せず、準備後にこちらへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. We will not send it today; please bring it here once ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お待たせしました。こちらが二名様のお飲み物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you for waiting. Here are the drinks for both of you.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 私は運転するのでノンアルコールを頼みました。どちらのグラスか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 運転するためノンアルコールのグラスを特定したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I ordered a nonalcoholic drink because I am driving. Please tell me which glass it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you are driving and want to identify the nonalcoholic glass. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 手前がノンアルコールの予定ですが、目印がないので注文と配膳を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: The nearer one should be nonalcoholic, but there is no marker, so I will check the order and serving.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 色が同じなので、自分たちで入れ替えたり味見したりせずに待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 見た目や味見で判断せず確認を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: They are the same color, so we will wait without swapping or tasting them ourselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Wait for confirmation rather than judging by appearance or tasting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。確認が済むまで、両方とも飲まずにお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. Please do not drink either until we have checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人の分はアルコール入りで、私の分だけノンアルコールです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二人の注文内容の違いを再確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. My friend's drink contains alcohol; only mine is nonalcoholic.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Reconfirm the difference between the two people's orders. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 確認したところ、配膳時の区別ができなくなっていました。この場面では二つとも交換します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: After checking, we found we could no longer distinguish them when serving. In this situation, we will replace both.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 交換後は私の方に目印を付けて、置く時にどちらか説明してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 交換後に目印と口頭説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: After replacing them, could you mark mine and explain which is which when you put them down?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask for a marker and a spoken explanation after replacement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、ノンアルコールの方に札を付けて、ご本人にお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, we will label the nonalcoholic drink and hand it directly to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: お願いします。友人のグラスと離して置き、説明を聞いてから飲みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: グラスを離して置き確認後に飲むと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please do. I will place it apart from my friend's glass and drink after hearing the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Decide to keep the glasses apart and drink after confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つを下げて、区別できる状態で改めてお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-FUNABASHI-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Certainly. I will take both away and bring them again clearly distinguished.

DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 内見はいかがでしたか。申込書はこちらになります。
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-01.translation: How was the viewing? Here is the application form.

DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 気に入りました。ただ、見たのは三〇二号室なのに、この紙は三〇一号室になっています。
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 内見した部屋と申込書の番号の不一致を指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I liked it. But I viewed room 302, while this paper says room 301.
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the mismatch between the room viewed and the number on the application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確認します。同じ間取りの空室が二つあり、別の用紙をお渡しした可能性があります。
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check. There are two vacant rooms with the same layout, and I may have given you the other form.

DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 間取りは同じでも、窓の向きが違うかもしれません。三〇二を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 間取り以外の違いを理由に希望の部屋を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Even with the same layout, the windows may face different directions. I would like to choose 302.
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify your preferred room, citing a difference other than layout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、希望は三〇二ですね。部屋番号と募集条件を照合してから用紙を交換します。
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, your preference is 302. I will match the room number and advertised terms before replacing the form.

DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 交換した紙にも、家賃と入居できる日をもう一度書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正しい部屋の家賃と入居日を再提示してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you write the rent and available move-in date on the replacement paper again too?
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the correct room's rent and move-in date to be shown again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 条件を確認した用紙をお渡しします。先ほどの紙にはまだ署名していませんか。
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will give you a form with the terms confirmed. Have you signed the earlier paper yet?

DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、名前を途中まで書きましたが、署名欄は空白です。間違った紙はどうすればいいですか。
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 途中まで書いた誤用紙の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I started writing my name, but the signature field is blank. What should I do with the incorrect paper?
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to handle the incorrect form you partly filled in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 当店で誤った用紙として回収します。新しい用紙を確認してから、申込むか決めてください。
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will collect it as an incorrect form. Check the new form before deciding whether to apply.

DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。部屋番号と条件が三〇二のものだと確認できるまで、署名はしません。
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部屋番号と条件の確認まで署名しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not sign until I can confirm the room number and terms are for 302.
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to sign until the room number and terms are confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。誤った用紙をお預かりし、三〇二号室の条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will take the incorrect form and check the terms for room 302.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日ご返却された本についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the books you returned today?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。さっき返した料理の本に、青いメモを挟んだままだったと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返却本に私物のメモを挟んだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I think I left a blue note inside the cookbook I returned a little while ago.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you left a personal note inside a returned book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本の題名か、返した冊数は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the title or how many books you returned?

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三冊返して、メモは「週末の料理」という本です。買い物の一覧を書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本の題名と返却冊数を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I returned three books. The note is in Weekend Cooking. I wrote a shopping list on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the book title and the number of books returned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返却後の本の所在を確認します。ご自身で書架の本を抜き出す前に、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check where the returned book is. Please wait here before taking books off the shelves yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。メモには電話番号もあるので、見つかったら周りに内容を見せずに渡してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 個人情報のあるメモを周囲に見せず返してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. The note also has a phone number, so if you find it, please return it without showing its contents to people nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the note containing personal information to be returned without showing it to others. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。メモの色と書いた内容の特徴を、確認担当者に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I will tell the staff member checking its color and distinctive content.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青い細長い紙で、上に「土曜日」と書いてあります。電話番号はここで声に出さなくてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: メモの特徴を示し番号の読み上げを避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is a long, narrow blue piece of paper with Saturday written at the top. Is it all right if I do not say the phone number aloud here?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the note's features and say you want to avoid reading the number aloud. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、番号をここで読み上げる必要はありません。特徴で確認し、必要なら静かな場所で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, there is no need to read the number aloud here. We will check the features and, if necessary, ask you in a quiet place.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。すぐに見つからない場合の連絡方法も確認してから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見できない場合の連絡方法も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Before going home, I will also check how you will contact me if it is not found immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will also check how you will be contacted if the note cannot be found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず本を確認し、その結果と連絡方法をこちらからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. First we will check the book, then explain the result and contact method.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのパンでお会計いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will ring up this bread for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し待ってください。これはチーズのパンだと思いましたが、札にはクリームと書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見た目と名称の違いから会計を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please wait a moment. I thought this was cheese bread, but the label says cream.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Stop checkout because the appearance and name differ. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは甘いクリームのパンです。チーズのパンは隣にありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is sweet cream bread. The cheese bread was next to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼食用なので甘くない方が欲しいです。でもトレーに載せた物を自分で棚に戻していいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 甘くない昼食用を希望し棚への戻し方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is for lunch, so I want something that is not sweet. But may I put something from my tray back on the shelf myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want nonsweet bread for lunch and check how to return the item to the shelf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 戻さず、こちらにお渡しください。この場面ではスタッフが扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please hand it to us rather than returning it. In this situation, staff will handle it.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ではお願いします。チーズのパンは中にもチーズが入っていますか、それとも上だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: チーズがパンのどこに入っているか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then please take it. Does the cheese bread have cheese inside too, or only on top?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where the cheese is in the bread. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 上にチーズを載せたパンです。中には入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is bread topped with cheese. There is none inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 中に具がある物を探しています。ほかに食事向けのパンはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 中に具がある別商品を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am looking for something with a filling. Do you have any other bread suitable for a meal?
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about a different item with a filling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 卵のサンドイッチがあります。冷蔵ケースの商品です。内容表示を見て選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have egg sandwiches in the refrigerated case. You can read the contents label before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それを見て決めます。今のクリームパンは買わず、会計もまだ待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元の商品を買わず選び直してから会計すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will look at those before deciding. I will not buy this cream bread; please keep checkout on hold.
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not buy the original item and will check out after choosing again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。クリームパンをお預かりし、選び直しのあとで会計いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-CHB-ICHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will take the cream bread and ring up your purchase after you choose again.
